vote_share: France-wide LaREM/MoDem 'Renaissance' list led by Nathalie Loiseau obtained 22.42% (national list, single constituency)
opponent: Rassemblement National list (Jordan Bardella) topped the poll at 23.34%
detail: Vedrenne was elected for the first time on the Renaissance (La République En Marche / MoDem majority) list. France uses a single national constituency with proportional representation; individual candidates do not have a personal vote share.

vote_share: Besoin d'Europe (Renaissance) list led by Valérie Hayer obtained about 14.6% nationally
opponent: Rassemblement National list (Jordan Bardella) won with about 31.4%
detail: Vedrenne ran in third position on the Besoin d'Europe / Renaissance list (behind Valérie Hayer and Bernard Guetta) and was re-elected. France uses a single national constituency; there is no individual candidate vote share.
